name: Saeki Mitsuru
source:
The protagonist's boss. Wears glasses, prefers minimal makeup. 
Dedicated and good at her job, she's an exceptional manager. 
Yet she is ashamed of her large breasts and somehow lacks confidence. 
She remains a virgin, is envious of her younger sister. 
Despite her rank, she speaks to everyone as though they are superior.
